SELECT da.Infopro_Div_Nbr, da.Acct_Nbr , isnull(max(coalesce(grp.is_erf_locked,ctr.is_erf_locked,0)),0) is_ERF_Locked , isnull(max(coalesce(grp.is_frf_locked,ctr.is_frf_locked,0)),0) is_FRF_Locked FROM Dim_Acct DA with (nolock) inner hash join Dim_Container_Grp dcg with (nolock) on dcg.Infopro_Div_Nbr=da.Infopro_Div_Nbr and dcg.Acct_Nbr =da.Acct_Nbr and /*@MONTH_END_DATE*/ CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(month, -(@MONTH)+1, DATEADD(s,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0)))) between dcg.Eff_Dt and dcg.Disc_Dt And dcg.Close_Dt >= /*@MONTH_END_DATE */ CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(month, -(@MONTH)+1, DATEADD(s,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0)))) left hash join Dim_Contract_Fee grp with (nolock) on grp.Infopro_Div_Nbr=da.Infopro_Div_Nbr and grp.Contract_Nbr =dcg.Contract_Nbr and grp.Contract_Grp_Nbr =dcg.Contract_Grp_Nbr and /*@MONTH_END_DATE*/ CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(month, -(@MONTH)+1, DATEADD(s,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0)))) between grp.Eff_Dt and grp.Disc_Dt left hash join Dim_Contract_Fee ctr with (nolock) on ctr.Infopro_Div_Nbr=da.Infopro_Div_Nbr and ctr.Contract_Nbr=dcg.Contract_Nbr and ctr.Contract_Grp_Nbr=0 and /*@MONTH_END_DATE*/ CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(month, -(@MONTH)+1, DATEADD(s,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0)))) between ctr.Eff_Dt and ctr.Disc_Dt where DA.Acct_Open_Dt <= /*@MONTH_END_DATE*/ CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(month, -(@MONTH)+1, DATEADD(s,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0)))) and /*@MONTH_END_DATE*/ CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(month, -(@MONTH)+1, DATEADD(s,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0)))) between DA.Eff_Dt AND DA.Disc_Dt And DA.Exception_Batch_ID is NULL --and DA.Infopro_Div_Nbr in ('015','046','902') group by da.Infopro_Div_Nbr, da.Acct_Nbr

DECLARE @pMONTH_NUM as INT SET @pMONTH_NUM =(Select MAX(Loop_Nbr) from Run_Loop_Contrl where Table_Name ='Fact_Monthly_Acct' and is_Processed=0); with DRH as( select * from( SELECT RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr, RH.Acct_Nbr, RH.Site_Nbr, RH.Container_Grp_Nbr, RH.Rate_Amt, RH.Disposal_UOM, CH.LOB_Category , CC.Charge_Cd as Charge_Cd, CC.Charge_Method as Charge_Method, CC.Charge_Typ as Charge_Typ, CG.Recurring_Charge_Freq as Recurring_Charge_Freq, CG.Pickup_Period_Total_Lifts as Pickup_Period_Total_Lifts, CG.Pickup_Period_Length, CG.Container_Cnt as Container_Cnt, CG.Container_Size as Container_Size, CG.is_Oncall as is_Oncall, CG.has_Compactor as has_Compactor, CG.is_Disposal_Billable as is_Disposal_Billable, CG.Revenue_Distribution_Cd as Revenue_Distribution_Cd, CONVERT(INT,Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Open_Dt, 112)),7),'-','')) Acct_Open_YYYYMM, CONVERT(INT,Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Close_Dt, 112)),7),'-','')) Acct_Close_YYYYMM, CONVERT(INT,REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','')) Report_Period_YYYYMM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr, RH.Acct_Nbr, RH.Site_Nbr, RH.Container_Grp_Nbr, RH.Charge_Cd_SK ORDER BY Rate_Disc_Dt Desc, Rate_SK Desc) RN
FROM Dim_Rate_Hist RH inner join Dim_Charge_Cd CC ON CC.Charge_Cd_SK = RH.Charge_Cd_SK and CC.Charge_Cd in ('REG','REC','REN','DSP','DIS','RBB') inner join Dim_Corp_Hier CH ON CH.Infopro_Div_Nbr = RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr and CH.Rev_Distrib_Cd = RH.Revenue_Distribution_Cd and CH.is_Current = 1 inner join Dim_Container_Grp CG ON CG.Infopro_Div_Nbr = RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr and CG.Acct_Nbr = RH.Acct_Nbr and CG.Site_Nbr = RH.Site_Nbr and CG.Container_Grp_Nbr = RH.Container_Grp_Nbr and CG.is_Current = 1 inner join Dim_Acct DA ON DA.Infopro_Div_Nbr = RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr and DA.Acct_Nbr = RH.Acct_Nbr and DA.is_Current = 1 AND ( /*NEW ACCT CHK*/ (Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Open_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') = REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') AND Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Close_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') > REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') ) OR /*LOST ACCT CHK*/ Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Close_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') = REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') )
WHERE
rh.Rate_Eff_Dt <= DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM-1), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01')) and rh.Rate_Disc_Dt > DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01')) and rh.Eff_Dt <= DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM-1), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01')) and rh.Disc_Dt > DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01'))) A where RN = 1 AND Acct_Open_YYYYMM = Report_Period_YYYYMM AND Acct_Close_YYYYMM > Report_Period_YYYYMM ), FSA as(select * from(select CG.Infopro_Div_Nbr, CG.Acct_Nbr, CG.Site_Nbr, CG.Container_Grp_Nbr, Monthly_Lift_Cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CG.Infopro_Div_Nbr, CG.Acct_Nbr, CG.Site_Nbr, CG.Container_Grp_Nbr ORDER BY FSA.EFF_DT_SK desc, FSA.Sales_Activity_PK Desc ) Rn

FROM Dim_Rate_Hist RH inner join Dim_Charge_Cd CC ON CC.Charge_Cd_SK = RH.Charge_Cd_SK and CC.Charge_Cd in ('REG','REC','REN','DSP','DIS','RBB') inner join Dim_Corp_Hier CH ON CH.Infopro_Div_Nbr = RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr and CH.Rev_Distrib_Cd = RH.Revenue_Distribution_Cd and CH.is_Current = 1 inner join Dim_Container_Grp CG ON CG.Infopro_Div_Nbr = RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr and CG.Acct_Nbr = RH.Acct_Nbr and CG.Site_Nbr = RH.Site_Nbr and CG.Container_Grp_Nbr = RH.Container_Grp_Nbr and CG.is_Current = 1 inner join Dim_Acct DA ON DA.Infopro_Div_Nbr = RH.Infopro_Div_Nbr and DA.Acct_Nbr = RH.Acct_Nbr and DA.is_Current = 1 AND ( /*NEW ACCT CHK*/ (Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Open_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') = REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') AND Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Close_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') > REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') ) OR /*LOST ACCT CHK*/ Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Close_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') = REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') )
WHERE
rh.Rate_Eff_Dt <= DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM-1), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01')) and rh.Rate_Disc_Dt > DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01')) and rh.Eff_Dt <= DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM-1), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01')) and rh.Disc_Dt > DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01'))) A where RN = 1 AND Acct_Open_YYYYMM = Report_Period_YYYYMM AND Acct_Close_YYYYMM > Report_Period_YYYYMM ), FSA as(select * from(select CG.Infopro_Div_Nbr, CG.Acct_Nbr, CG.Site_Nbr, CG.Container_Grp_Nbr, Monthly_Lift_Cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CG.Infopro_Div_Nbr, CG.Acct_Nbr, CG.Site_Nbr, CG.Container_Grp_Nbr ORDER BY FSA.EFF_DT_SK desc, FSA.Sales_Activity_PK Desc ) Rn
from dbo.Fact_Sales_Activity FSA INNER JOIN Dim_Container_Grp CG ON CG.Container_Grp_SK = FSA.Container_Grp_SK
INNER JOIN Dim_Acct DA ON DA.Infopro_Div_Nbr = CG.Infopro_Div_Nbr AND DA.Acct_Nbr = CG.Acct_Nbr /* FILTER FOR ONLY NEW ACCOUNTS IN THE LOAD MONTH */ AND Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Open_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') = REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') AND Replace(LEFT(convert(date, CONVERT(varchar(50), DA.Acct_Close_Dt, 112)),7),'-','') > REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') AND DATEADD(day,-1,convert(date,LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM-1), GETDATE()), 20),7)+'-01')) between DA.Eff_Dt AND DA.Disc_Dt
where Sales_Activity_Period_SK = REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','')
and FSA.is_Deleted <> 1 and FSA.is_Updated <> 1)B where rn=1), SRC as (select Infopro_Div_Nbr,Acct_Nbr,Rate_Amt,Disposal_UOM,UPPER(LOB_Category) as LOB_Category, Charge_Cd,Charge_Method,Charge_Typ,Container_Size,has_Compactor,ISNULL(Monthly_Lift_Cnt,0) as Monthly_Lift_Cnt from( select drh.Infopro_Div_Nbr,drh.Acct_Nbr,Charge_Cd,Charge_Method,Charge_Typ,Rate_Amt,is_Oncall,Pickup_Period_Length,has_Compactor,Container_Size, Pickup_Period_Total_Lifts,Monthly_Lift_Cnt,Recurring_Charge_Freq,Container_Cnt,LOB_Category,is_Disposal_Billable,Disposal_UOM from DRH left outer join FSA on DRH.infopro_div_nbr=FSA.infopro_div_nbr and DRH.ACCT_nbr=FSA.ACCT_nbr and DRH.site_nbr=FSA.site_nbr and DRH.container_grp_nbr=FSA.container_grp_nbr )A where is_Disposal_Billable = 1 AND (LOB_Category = 'INDUSTRIAL' OR LOB_Category = 'INDUSTRIAL RECYCLING')) select Infopro_Div_Nbr,Acct_Nbr,SUM_Industrial_Disp_Rev_Amt,SUM_Industrial_Rcyl_Disp_Rev_Amt from( select Infopro_Div_Nbr,Acct_Nbr,SUM(Industrial_Disp_Rev_Amt) SUM_Industrial_Disp_Rev_Amt ,SUM(Industrial_Rcyl_Disp_Rev_Amt) as SUM_Industrial_Rcyl_Disp_Rev_Amt from( select AVGG.Infopro_Div_Nbr,Acct_Nbr,CASE WHEN LOB_Category = 'INDUSTRIAL' THEN CASE WHEN (Charge_Typ='R' and Charge_Method = 'F') OR (Charge_Typ='S' and Charge_Method = 'Q') OR (Charge_Typ='R' and Charge_Method = 'Q') THEN CASE WHEN Charge_Cd = 'DSP' OR Charge_Cd = 'DIS' THEN CASE WHEN Disposal_UOM = 'TN' THEN CASE WHEN has_Compactor = 1 THEN CASE WHEN Compactor_Hauls > 0 THEN Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * (Compactor_Tons/Compactor_Hauls) ELSE 0 end ELSE CASE WHEN Open_Top_Hauls > 0 THEN Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * (Open_Top_Tons/Open_Top_Hauls) ELSE 0 end end ELSE Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * Container_Size end ELSE 0 end ELSE 0 end ELSE 0 end as Industrial_Disp_Rev_Amt, case when LOB_Category = 'INDUSTRIAL RECYCLING' THEN case when (Charge_Typ='R' and Charge_Method = 'F') OR (Charge_Typ='S' and Charge_Method = 'Q') OR (Charge_Typ='R' and Charge_Method = 'Q') THEN case when Charge_Cd = 'DSP' OR Charge_Cd = 'DIS' THEN case when Disposal_UOM = 'TN' THEN case when has_Compactor = 1 THEN case when Compactor_Recycle_Hauls > 0 THEN Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * (Compactor_Recycle_Tons/Compactor_Recycle_Hauls) ELSE 0 end ELSE case when Open_Top_Recycle_Hauls > 0 THEN Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * (Open_Top_Recycle_Tons/Open_Top_Recycle_Hauls) ELSE 0 end end ELSE Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * Container_Size end
ELSE case when Charge_Cd = 'RBB' THEN case when has_Compactor = 1 THEN case when Compactor_Recycle_Hauls > 0 THEN Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * (Compactor_Recycle_Tons/Compactor_Recycle_Hauls) ELSE 0 end ELSE case when Open_Top_Recycle_Hauls > 0 THEN Rate_Amt * Monthly_Lift_Cnt * (Open_Top_Recycle_Tons/Open_Top_Recycle_Hauls) ELSE 0 end end ELSE 0 end end ELSE 0 end ELSE 0 end as Industrial_Rcyl_Disp_Rev_Amt from SRC inner join(Select AD.Infopro_Div_Nbr, AD.Open_Top_Tons, AD.Open_Top_Recycle_Tons, AD.Compactor_Tons, AD.Compactor_Recycle_Tons, AD.Open_Top_Hauls, AD.Open_Top_Recycle_Hauls, AD.Compactor_Hauls, AD.Compactor_Recycle_Hauls FROM Agg_Divisional_Avg AD Where AD.Monthly_Period_SK = REPLACE(LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(50), DATEADD(month, -(@pMONTH_NUM), GETDATE()), 102),7),'.','') ) AVGG on src.Infopro_Div_Nbr=AVGG.Infopro_Div_Nbr )A group by Infopro_Div_Nbr,Acct_Nbr)C where SUM_Industrial_Disp_Rev_Amt>0 or SUM_Industrial_Rcyl_Disp_Rev_Amt>0

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(is_Oncall = '0', IIF(Charge_Typ = 'R', IIF(Charge_Method = 'F', (Rate_Amt * Recurring_Charge_Freq)/12 ,IIF(Charge_Method = 'Q', (Rate_Amt * Container_Cnt * Recurring_Charge_Freq)/12, 0)), IIF(Pickup_Period_Length > 0, IIF(Charge_Typ = 'S' AND Charge_Method = 'Q', (Rate_Amt * (Pickup_Period_Total_Lifts/Pickup_Period_Length) * 52)/12 ,0) ,0)) ,IIF(is_Oncall = '1',IIF(Charge_Typ = 'S' AND Charge_Method = 'Q',(Rate_Amt * IIF(ISNULL(Avg_Hauls),0,Avg_Hauls)) ,0),0))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_Comm_Rev_Amt

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(UPPER(LOB_Category) = 'INDUSTRIAL',IIF((Charge_Typ ='R' AND Charge_Method = 'F') OR (Charge_Typ ='S' AND Charge_Method = 'Q') OR (Charge_Typ = 'R' AND Charge_Method = 'Q'),IIF(Charge_Cd ='DSP' OR Charge_Cd ='DIS',IIF(Disposal_UOM ='TN',(Rate_Amt * Avg_Tons), (Rate_Amt * Avg_Hauls * Container_Size)))))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_Industrial_Disp_Rev_Amt

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(UPPER(LOB_Category) = 'INDUSTRIAL RECYCLING', IIF((Charge_Typ ='R' AND Charge_Method = 'F') OR (Charge_Typ ='S' AND Charge_Method = 'Q') OR (Charge_Typ = 'R' AND Charge_Method = 'Q'), IIF(Charge_Cd ='DIS' OR Charge_Cd ='DSP' OR Charge_Cd ='RBB', IIF(Disposal_UOM ='TN', (Rate_Amt * Avg_Tons), (Rate_Amt * Avg_Hauls * Container_Size)))))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_Industrial_Rcyl_Disp_Rev_Amt

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(Charge_Typ = 'R' AND Charge_Method ='F', (Rate_Amt * Recurring_Charge_Freq ) /12, IIF(Charge_Typ ='S' AND Charge_Method = 'Q', (Rate_Amt * v_Avg_Hauls), IIF(Charge_Typ = 'R' AND Charge_Method = 'Q', (Rate_Amt * Container_Cnt * Recurring_Charge_Freq ) /12,0)))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_RevAmt

SELECT FMA.Monthly_Account_PK, FMA.Report_Period_SK, FMA.Infopro_Div_Nbr, FMA.Acct_Nbr, fma1.Assigned_GL_Div_Nbr --Prev_Assigned_GL_Div_Nbr FROM (SELECT fma.Monthly_Account_PK, fma.Report_Period_SK, dima.Infopro_Div_Nbr, dima.Acct_Nbr, fma.InfoPro_Div_SK, fma.Acct_SK FROM DWCORE.dbo.Fact_Monthly_Acct AS fma INNER JOIN DWCORE.dbo.Dim_Acct AS dima ON fma.Acct_SK = dima.Acct_SK WHERE fma.Report_Period_SK = CONVERT(INT, LEFT(Replace(CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), Dateadd(month, -( select MAX(Loop_Nbr) from dwcore..Run_Loop_Contrl where Table_Name='Fact_Monthly_Acct' and is_Processed=0 ), Getdate()), 102), '.', ''), 6)) ) FMA
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT FM.Report_Period_SK, dima1.Infopro_Div_Nbr, dima1.Acct_Nbr, FM.Assigned_GL_Div_Nbr FROM DWCORE.dbo.Fact_Monthly_Acct FM INNER JOIN DWCORE.dbo.Dim_Acct AS dima1 ON FM.Acct_SK = dima1.Acct_SK ) fma1 ON fma1.Infopro_Div_Nbr = FMA.Infopro_Div_Nbr AND fma1.Acct_Nbr = FMA.Acct_Nbr AND fma1.Report_Period_SK = CONVERT(INT, LEFT(Replace(CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), Dateadd(month, -( (select MAX(Loop_Nbr) from dwcore..Run_Loop_Contrl where Table_Name='Fact_Monthly_Acct' and is_Processed=0)+1 ), Getdate()), 102), '.', ''), 6))

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
SELECT
TempOne.Infopro_Div_Nbr, TempOne.Acct_Nbr, TempOne.Revenue_Period_SK, Min(TempOne.Div_Nbr)
FROM ( SELECT fid.Revenue_Period_SK, dcg.Infopro_Div_Nbr, dcg.Acct_Nbr, fid.Div_Nbr, SUM(fid.Invoice_Amt) AS [Invoced_Amount], RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY fid.Revenue_Period_SK,dcg.Infopro_Div_Nbr, dcg.Acct_Nbr ORDER BY SUM(fid.Invoice_Amt) DESC ) AS [Rank]
FROM ( SELECT fid.Invoice_Detail_PK, fid.Revenue_Period_SK, fid.Container_Grp_SK, dGLh.Div_Nbr, fid.Invoice_Amt FROM DWCORE.dbo.Fact_Invoice_Detail AS fid INNER JOIN DWCORE.dbo.Dim_InfoPro_Hier AS dIPh ON fid.InfoPro_Hier_SK = dIPh.InfoPro_Hier_SK and dIPh.InfoPro_Hier_SK > 0 INNER JOIN DWCORE.dbo.Dim_GL_Hier AS dGLh ON dIPh.Cur_GL_Hier_SK = dGLh.GL_Hier_SK and dGLh.GL_Hier_SK > 0 WHERE fid.is_Updated = 0 and fid.Container_Grp_SK > 0 and fid.Revenue_Period_SK = CONVERT(INT, LEFT(Replace(CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), Dateadd(month, -( select MAX(Loop_Nbr) from dwcore..Run_Loop_Contrl where Table_Name='Fact_Monthly_Acct' and is_Processed=0 ), Getdate()), 102), '.', ''), 6)) ) AS fid
INNER JOIN DWCORE.dbo.Dim_Container_Grp AS dcg ON fid.Container_Grp_SK = dcg.Container_Grp_SK
GROUP BY fid.Revenue_Period_SK, dcg.Infopro_Div_Nbr, dcg.Acct_Nbr, fid.Div_Nbr ) AS TempOne
WHERE TempOne.[Rank] = 1 GROUP BY TempOne.Infopro_Div_Nbr, TempOne.Acct_Nbr, TempOne.Revenue_Period_SK

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Post SQL

begin
MERGE DWCORE.dbo.Fact_Monthly_Acct AS fma USING (SELECT DISTINCT Monthly_Account_PK,Assigned_GL_Div_Nbr FROM DWCORE.dbo.ETL_FACT_MONTHLY_ACCT_UPd) UPD ON UPD.Monthly_Account_PK=FMA.Monthly_Account_PK WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET FMA.Assigned_GL_Div_Nbr=UPD.Assigned_GL_Div_Nbr\; end;
